latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of PRINZCLAW — Unified OpenClaw Skill.

- Integrates full agent evaluation with both loyalty and argue scoring in a dual-dimension system.
- Five core commands: `/prinzclaw`, `/loyaltycore`, `/arguecore`, `/eventdrop`, and `/configshare`.
- Detailed scoring frameworks for agent loyalty (pro-American stance) and argue intensity (combat posture).
- Arena event deployment, agent config publishing/sharing, and real-time leaderboard support.
- Modular JavaScript exports for streamlined integration and usage.
